narrativeProgression.description: Introduction of the experimental setup using a cylindrical mirror and a laser pulse.
Formation of a primary elastic wave after the laser pulse hits the mirror.
Generation of multicomponent elastic waves at the edge of the illuminated area.
Introduction of piezoelectric sensors to detect the presence of elastic waves.
Display of the temporal evolution of the out-of-plane displacement at the sensor location, highlighting the arrival of the primary wave (P-wave).
The P-wave reaches the opposite side of the mirror, and different types of waves begin to separate.
Visualization of the total mechanical energy distribution and its division among different wave types (R-wave, S-wave, and P-wave).
Similar analysis for the normal component of momentum, showcasing its distribution among different wave types.
Focus on the wave pattern of displacement, highlighting the arrival of the Rayleigh wave (Rn-wave) generated at the near edge of the illuminated area.
Observation of the arrival of the second Rayleigh wave (Rf-wave) originating from the far edge of the illuminated area.
Identification of the arrival of the reflected P-wave (2P-wave) after bouncing off the mirror's rear surface.
Detection of the arrival of a transformed wave (PS-wave).
Continuous animation showcasing the complete wave propagation without pauses.

text_to_speech: We have conducted an experimental and numerical study of elastic waves driven by the momentum of light. The configuration consists of a cylindrical mirror illuminated at normal incidence by laser pulse beam. Immediately after illumination, a dominant primary elastic wave is created beneath the illuminated area. At this time frame, multicomponent elastic waves are generated from the edges of the illuminated area. In order to detect the presence of the elastic waves, piezoelectric detectors are deployed on the same side and opposite side of illumination. Shown below is a plot of the normal displacement versus time at the sensor location highlighted in green. The features of the displacement waveform can be correlated to the arrival of different wave types at the sensor location. At this instant in time, the waveform feature corresponds to the arrival of the primary wave generated on the nearer edge of the illuminated area. At this time frame, the primary wave just arrives at the back of the mirror and the different components of the elastic wave begin to decouple. The total mechanical energy of the elastic wave, 1.96 fJ, can be subdivided into different wave volumes. 3% of the mechanical energy resides in the Rayleigh wave volume, highlighted in yellow. 11% resides in the secondary wave volume, highlighted in blue and 86% resides in the primary wave volume, highlighted in red. The same can be done for the normal momentum of the wave, which is twice that of the incident pulse momentum. -32% of the wave momentum resides in the Rayleigh wave volume 106% resides in the secondary wave volume and 26% resides in the primary wave volume. Going back to the displacement waveforms, the feature here corresponds the arrival of the Rayleigh wave generated on the nearer edge of the illuminated area. The feature here corresponds the arrival of the Rayleigh wave generated on the farther edge of the illuminated area. The feature here corresponds to the arrival of the primary wave that is reflected from the back of the mirror and the feature here corresponds to the arrival of the mode converted wave. The animation is shown again without any pauses. This includes the incident illumination, the generation and propagation of multicomponent elastic waves throughout the mirror, and the correlation of the elastic wave components to the measured displacement waveform measured at the sensor location highlighted in green.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Izvedli smo experimentale numerično reziskava elastičnih valov, kih pozruči prenozgibalne količine svetlove.
V experimentu smo porabili cilindično za arcalo, kih smoga pod praven kotomo svetlili z lastarskim bliskom.
Takoj posvetljiti, po to svetljenimo poči, imprevala doje primarni elastičnival.
Tem trenutku se na robo svetljenega močja i seva joveč komponentni elastičnivalovi.
Debe u kutovili prisotnost elastičnih valov, smo na izdji strani i na nasprutni strani je so klitve na mislili pijezo električna za znavala.
Spoda je prikazančasonje potek izvendranjicka ga pomika na mislo za znavala, kih barvan zeleno.
Po samez ne potezvalovne u blikel, ko povežemo sprihodam različnih vrstvalovna mislo za znavala.
U tem trenutku valovna potezavstri za prihodo primarni ga vala, k je nastavna bližnam robo svetljenega močja.
U tem trenutku je primarni vala raunov prispil do zadnje površine za rcala.
Po samez nevarstje elastičnih valov se prično je uločevati.
Znavalovna potezavstri za znavala na mislo za znavala.
Trudz stodke mehanske energie se na hajavareli vam območil, kih oznaceno stromeno.
Na izstodko je zajeteval močje sekundarnih valov, oznaceno smodro.
Sresinosno je to stodko je prebihovalu v vlugnu primarnih valov, oznaceno za rdječa.
Enako velja z normalno komponento kibalne količine, k je doakrat večav dopadne kibalne količine svrlobnega bliska.
Minus 23 sodstodko u te komponento kibalne količine valov se na hajavareli vam območil.
16 sodstodko je prebihovalu mno se kondarnih valov, in 26 sodstodko je najdemo območil primarne ga valovanja.
Varnimo se navalonu blika pomika.
Tapu teza v streza prihodo rejljeve ga vala, pognal nega zbližnika robos odljenega območil.
Tapu teza v streza prihodo rejljeve ga vala, k je nostav na dalj nam robos odljenega območil.
Tapu teza v streza prihodo primarne ga vala, kis je odbijut za tne površine za rcala.
In tapu teza v streza prihodo enkrad problikovanega vala.
Oglemos je animacijo še enkrad brezu mesnih premorov.

Animacijo ključujo svetlita uz lasaskim bliskom, torbom širi neveč komponentnih lastišnih valovs motrizacala, in ujemani je posameznih komponentel lastišnih valovs potizami zmiri nevalonu oblikena misto znavala k je barvan zelenu.
